name: Rush Trigger Styler
author: pluscodes

sections.description:
Rush Trigger Styler is a powerful and flexible plugin that helps you create urgency and drive conversions on your WooCommerce store. With customizable rush triggers, you can display time-limited offers, countdown timers, and important announcements to your customers.

Key Features

  • Customizable Styling: Completely customize the colors, text, and appearance of your rush trigger
  • Countdown Timer: Add a real-time countdown to create urgency
  • Flexible Positioning: Place your trigger at the top or bottom of your site
  • Animation Options: Choose from several animation styles
  • Page-specific Display: Control which pages show your rush trigger
  • Mobile Responsive: Looks great on all devices
  • WooCommerce Integration: Seamlessly works with your WooCommerce store
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rush-trigger-styler folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Rush Trigger to configure your settings
sections.faq:
Can I display different triggers on different pages?

Currently, the plugin displays the same trigger across all enabled pages. We’re working on adding page-specific triggers in a future update.

Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Rush Trigger Styler is designed to work with any WordPress theme. The styling is self-contained and won’t conflict with your theme styles.

Can I change the font or add custom CSS?

The current version uses your theme’s default font. We plan to add custom font options and CSS capabilities in future updates.
